recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-25396; any future changes to external category code spellings or additions should go through terminology/UTG rather than this core-source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-25396 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue requesting that AdverseEvent.category be bound at Example strength and that the category value set be broadened to include wrong patient, procedure mishap, medication mishap, device, unsafe physical environment, hospital acquired infection, and wrong body site.
initial_application: Commit faf138c4d6 directly applied FHIR-25396 in the old AdverseEvent spreadsheet by changing the category binding from extensible to example, replacing the old product-focused category list with the requested examples, adding the FHIR-25396 committee note, and updating the AdverseEvent example to medication-mishap. The current refactored source preserves those semantics in structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml and valueset-adverse-event-category.xml.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. The current value set includes all codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/adverse-event-category, so individual code membership is supplied by external THO terminology. Later FHIR-38908 and UP-597 added clinical-research to the same category terminology and were already represented on the combined branch by ad68f5c5d8; that later addition explains the extra current-source code in the local summary/search text.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit.
